nits.problem: The guide does not tell the administrator which organization-specific addresses to use for the required User support email and Contact Information fields.
nits.suggestion: Add one section-level hedge directing the administrator to obtain the support and contact email addresses from the application or cloud security owner when they are not specified in the setup ticket.

open_questions: Google's Compute MCP page lists compute.read-only and compute.read-write scope strings, while the live protected-resource metadata advertises only https://www.googleapis.com/auth/compute; the Dossier uses the endpoint-advertised scope pending confirmation of the alternatives.
Public docs do not establish whether declaring the Compute scope under Data Access is required for Internal apps; the walkthrough includes it unconditionally.

Some console navigation seams are inferred because public docs provide deep links or destination names rather than complete menu paths, particularly IAM and Google Auth platform subsection navigation.
Google does not publicly classify the Compute scope as non-sensitive, sensitive, or restricted, so External-app verification requirements remain uncertain.
Google documents operation-dependent Compute permissions but not a minimal role set for read-only MCP use.
Google documents deleting and recreating a lost client secret but does not name the exact console control or detail-page path.

history.revision_notes: Updated external.md to replace the definitive Project Owner claim with the documented permissions; describe the catalog entry as connecting to Google’s hosted MCP Server without installation or pasting a remote URL; condition Service Account User on VMs that run as a service account; qualify the inferred API Library and IAM navigation routes and provide documented direct links; hedge the client-secret recovery transition; and direct admins to check audience and publishing status on the Audience page, with an owner fallback when values are unclear. Updated meta.yaml to remove the unsupported Project Owner assertion from credential_setup.requirements[gcp-project]. Updated research.md first to record the Audience-page check and owner fallback as part of the Dossier fact ceiling. Existing anchors and the catalog-only Speakeasy path were preserved.

research_change.notes: The Speakeasy add-server flow materially changed from unresolved catalog presence with both catalog and custom-remote branches to a confirmed catalog-only path. AFTER adds `speakeasy_add_server: catalog`, records the matched `com.googleapis.compute/mcp` / Google Compute Engine catalog entry, removes the catalog open question, and specifies the catalog UI sequence. This requires re-rendering `speakeasy.md` and invalidates review of the previous dual-path setup. Provider credentials, remote URL, transport, prerequisites, and anchors are otherwise unchanged.
